reviews.note: Earliest telling, 25 June 2026, eighteen days before the 13 July version this claim was seeded from. He gives the current figure of thirty one himself, which makes the gap he is calling explicit and checkable.
He asserts both that America is going to be okay and that a shaking is coming, in the same breath.
Bad counsel around the president, with an explicit refusal to blame the president himself.
Do not trust Turkey, given in prayer form.
He describes the mechanism as getting a check inside rather than a stated word.

He prays both that the president be protected if he goes and for divine delays so that he does not. Both outcomes are covered, and the visit went ahead on 7 July without incident, which is now on the record as evidence.
Protective prayer over the president with no named threat.
Adds the Venezuela comparison for street splitting, freshly available from that week's news.
Puts Vancouver as the epicentre and Yellowstone as the secondary effect. There is no established mechanism by which a Cascadia event triggers Yellowstone.
A sung worship passage.
Both acts pushed through in prayer with a financial outpouring attached.
He answers the objection that he has been saying this for a long time by tightening it to on the heels of it. That is a real narrowing of a previously open claim.
Names Turkey as wanting Putin to remove Zelensky, which is a specific alignment.
He places himself inside the Turkey and Russia meeting in the spirit.
New claim, and he asks four times why he is seeing it without offering an interpretation. An uninterpreted image can be attached to anything later.
Macron's influence at the Turkey meeting, with the presence itself hedged.
Moves the persecution claim onto America and adds that they have not seen the beginning of it. The greater glory clause makes persecution the proof and its absence no disproof.
A Turkey and Poland meeting read as the Warsaw word forming. Bilateral meetings between NATO members are routine.
The vampire stretching out, applied to a diplomatic meeting.
The euro in trouble, given alongside a Russian statement calling Germany Nazi, which he agrees with.
A Russian government clip played without comment. Not a claim he makes.
European independent armament claimed as called. European strategic autonomy has been an open policy debate since 2017, so this is not against the run of the news.
He claims the word betrayal appearing in headlines as the match. Betrayal is common headline vocabulary, so the bar is low.
Refusal of service to Israelis in New York claimed as the all time high arriving. Recorded antisemitic incidents were already at documented record levels before this word.
Names a ministry as funding the return and adds the Gaza occupation angering people.
He prays the churches will not burn while also claiming they will. Both directions are covered.
The count rises from four to seven. Recorded as a number change rather than a new claim.
New claim. He corrects himself from South Korea to China mid-passage, which is worth recording as how the detail is fixed.
Names the former governor and a congresswoman and adds Google, which makes it checkable against any actual case.
Adds the fifty gallon black drums with a silver lining. The fifty gallon drum image recurs across several unrelated claims in this corpus, which weakens it as a distinguishing detail.
The new suit rebrand tied to the China barrel and the Minnesota figure being afraid.
Not enough room to receive it, extended from churches to stadiums.
Earliest telling, 23 June 2026, eleven days before the 4 July version this claim was seeded from. Adds the coliseums not holding them.

Brazil shaken with a South American revival following. Brazil sits in the stable interior of the South American plate and does not produce damaging earthquakes, which makes this a hard call rather than a safe one.
New claim. The condition puts any harm on the hearer's failure to anoint, which makes it unfalsifiable as put.
Preaching rather than politics as the mechanism for national change, third such passage in four batches.
A transition between segments.
Puts a number on it: three major churches, with healings and creative miracles. That is more checkable than the general revival claim.
The lead casing defeating the sniffers, with American aircraft searching for it.
He cannot fix the period and says so, offering the Kennedy era or perhaps the 1980s, which spans two decades.
New claim, and it pre-explains a null result: if nothing is ever found in Cuba, it was removed in time.
He leaves symbolic or literal open explicitly, which allows either reading after the fact. Worth having in his own words.
Names a Miami pastor as leading the effort, which makes the claim attributable to an identifiable person.
New claim, and unusual for this corpus in predicting failure inside a movement he is otherwise promoting.
Red wave used here for both a political and a religious result without distinguishing them, which makes either outcome claimable.
Attributes the arson to the Muslim Brotherhood specifically and names Toronto. Investigations into church arson in North America have generally found other causes.
A commentator's remark about needing another Pearl Harbor treated as significant. He cannot identify the speaker and says so.
He ties the commentator's remark to the ground zero image he keeps seeing.
He identifies the weapon in the footage as a Tomahawk, which fixes the type.
Turkey blocking the strait to aid Russia. Turkey has closed the strait to warships of both belligerents since 2022 under Montreux, which is the opposite alignment.
Making the web through meetings. Diplomatic tours are Zelensky's standing practice, so this sits at the base rate.
Attacks on Warsaw from Russia, restated against Poland being in the news.
The swastika and Hitler spirit repeated alongside strikes on bridges, with a statement that it is not de-escalating.
New claim. A felt sense with no stated referent, so nothing here can fail.
The oil moved from a press to the mouths of preachers in Canada, Toronto and Europe.
